excerpt: ReSO is a generative engine optimisation platform from New Delhi that tracks how brands appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers and sets weekly fixes.
content:
ReSO is a generative engine optimisation (GEO) platform: it helps brands show up when buyers ask AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews which product to choose. It builds a list of high-intent buyer questions for your category, tracks how often your brand and named competitors appear in the answers, and finds citation gaps. It then turns the audit into a weekly action plan: technical fixes to make your site easier for AI systems to read, and content written to be cited.

The founder said on Product Hunt that ReSO weighs more than 400 parameters to prioritise fixes, delivers 8 on-site fixes and 2 ready-to-publish content pieces a week, and that people still make the site changes themselves. The paid plan is $599 a month; a one-off free report is available on sign-up.

ReSO is run by ReSO AI Solutions Private Limited of New Delhi, according to its privacy policy. Its co-founders on Product Hunt are Swati Paliwal, who says she has led marketing for two decades, and Mohit Gupta. ReSO launched there on 10 October 2026 and finished #2 for the day and #5 for the week, with 495 upvotes and 43 comments (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested ReSO ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page and privacy policy, its Product Hunt launch and the public pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

paragraphs: Swati Paliwal says organic growth was her favourite channel in two decades of B2B and B2C marketing, until she noticed her own buying change: every serious purchase now started with a question to ChatGPT or Google AI.
When buyers ask AI which product to choose, she says only three to five brands make it into the answer, and every brand left out loses a potential customer. ReSO was built to audit that and fix it.
launch_story.attribution: Swati Paliwal, co-founder, on Product Hunt

pricing.intro: ReSO lists a free one-off report, a monthly plan and a custom scope. Prices are in US dollars.

plans.name: Free (one-off)
plans.detail: A one-time AI visibility report on sign-up, 6 technical fixes and one blog written to be cited

plans.name: Monthly
plans.detail: ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews; 30 prompts tracked; monthly report; intent scoring; citation and white-space gap analysis; 1 AI-optimised landing page and 5 blogs a month

plans.name: Custom
plans.detail: Adds Claude, Copilot and Gemini; 75+ prompts; biweekly reports; competitor benchmarking; multi-region tracking; CMS publishing pipeline

faq.a: A generative engine optimisation platform that tracks how your brand appears in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, and gives weekly fixes and content to improve it.
There is a free one-off report on sign-up. The monthly plan is $599, and a custom scope adds more engines, prompts and competitor benchmarking.
ReSO AI Solutions Private Limited of New Delhi, co-founded by Swati Paliwal and Mohit Gupta.

faq.q: Does ReSO change my website automatically?
faq.a: No. The founder said a person still makes the recommended changes; ReSO tells you which issues to fix each week.

faq.q: Which AI engines does it track?
faq.a: ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews on the monthly plan; the custom scope adds Claude, Copilot and Gemini.
